passages.text: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. His mother’s name was Jerushah daughter of Zadok.
passages.sermon:
Jotham became king when he was twenty-five years old.
Jotham ruled in Jerusalem.
He reigned for sixteen years.
Jotham’s mother was Jerushah.
Jerushah was the daughter of Zadok.
passages.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ יוֹתָ֣ם בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ יְרוּשָׁ֖ה בַּת־ צָדֽוֹק׃

passages.text: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Uzziah had done. In addition, he did not enter the temple of the LORD. But the people still behaved corruptly.
passages.sermon:
Jotham was king in Jerusalem.
Jotham did what was right.
He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
He acted as his father Uzziah had acted.
Jotham did not enter the temple of the LORD.
The people still acted corruptly.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֜ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה כְּכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂה֙ עֻזִּיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֔יו רַ֕ק לֹא־ בָ֖א אֶל־ הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה וְע֥וֹד הָעָ֖ם מַשְׁחִיתִֽים׃

passages.text: Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the house of the LORD, and he worked extensively on the wall at the hill of Ophel.
passages.sermon:
Jotham was king in Jerusalem.
Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the house of the LORD.
Jotham also worked on the wall at the hill of Ophel.
He built much of this wall.
passages.original: ה֗וּא בָּנָ֛ה אֶת־ שַׁ֥עַר בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה הָעֶלְי֑וֹן וּבְחוֹמַ֥ת הָעֹ֛פֶל בָּנָ֖ה לָרֹֽב׃

passages.text: He also built cities in the hill country of Judah and fortresses and towers in the forests.
passages.sermon:
Jotham was king of Judah.
Jotham built cities in the hill country of Judah.
Jotham built fortresses in the forests.
Jotham built towers in the forests.
passages.original: וְעָרִ֥ים בָּנָ֖ה בְּהַר־ יְהוּדָ֑ה וּבֶחֳרָשִׁ֣ים בָּנָ֔ה בִּֽירָנִיּ֖וֹת וּמִגְדָּלִֽים׃

passages.text: Jotham waged war against the king of the Ammonites and defeated them, and that year they gave him a hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat, and ten thousand cors of barley. They paid him the same in the second and third years.
passages.sermon:
Jotham was king of Judah.
Jotham fought against the king of the Ammonites.
Jotham defeated the Ammonites.
That year, the Ammonites gave Jotham one hundred talents of silver.
They also gave him ten thousand cors of wheat.
They gave him ten thousand cors of barley.
The Ammonites paid Jotham the same amount in the second year.
They paid him the same amount in the third year.
passages.original: וְ֠הוּא נִלְחַ֞ם עִם־ מֶ֣לֶךְ בְּנֵי־ עַמּוֹן֮ וַיֶּחֱזַ֣ק עֲלֵיהֶם֒ וַיִּתְּנוּ־ ל֨וֹ בְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֜וֹן בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַהִ֗יא מֵאָה֙ כִּכַּר־ כֶּ֔סֶף וַעֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֤ים כֹּרִים֙ חִטִּ֔ים וּשְׂעוֹרִ֖ים עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים זֹ֗את הֵשִׁ֤יבוּ לוֹ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹןס וּבַשָּׁנָ֥ה הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית וְהַשְּׁלִשִֽׁית׃

passages.text: So Jotham grew powerful because he ordered his ways before the LORD his God.
passages.sermon:
Jotham was king of Judah.
Jotham became strong.
Jotham grew powerful.
Jotham prepared his ways before the LORD his God.
Jotham lived in obedience to God.
Jotham followed God's ways.
God gave Jotham strength because of his obedience.
passages.original: וַיִּתְחַזֵּ֖ק יוֹתָ֑ם כִּ֚י הֵכִ֣ין דְּרָכָ֔יו לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Jotham, along with all his wars and his ways, they are indeed written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
passages.sermon:
Jotham was a king of Judah.
He fought wars.
He had certain ways and actions.
Writers recorded the rest of Jotham’s acts.
They also recorded all his wars.
They also recorded his ways.
They wrote these things in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
passages.original: וְיֶתֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י יוֹתָ֔ם וְכָל־ מִלְחֲמֹתָ֖יו וּדְרָכָ֑יו הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל־ סֵ֥פֶר מַלְכֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִיהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years.
passages.sermon: Jotham became king when he was twenty-five years old.\r\nHe ruled in Jerusalem.\r\nHe reigned for sixteen years.
passages.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וְחָמֵ֛שׁ שָׁנָ֖ה הָיָ֣ה בְמָלְכ֑וֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: And Jotham rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David. And his son Ahaz reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Jotham was king of Judah.
Jotham died.
People buried Jotham in the City of David.
Ahaz was Jotham’s son.
Ahaz became king after Jotham.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יוֹתָם֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָחָ֥ז בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
